actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

facts.text: The model sets its integration step to 0.0001 s, gravity (0, 0, -981), density 0.00128 and viscosity 0.000185
The environment loads the model from assets/fruitfly.xml (the file this package carries as model.xml)
The floor scene includes fruitfly.xml and adds a 5 by 5 plane floor at z -0.132
The action groups are adhesion, head, mouth, antennae, wings, abdomen, legs and user, each disabled until it is enabled
The root body carries the free joint named 'free'
The actuator section declares the model's actuators as general and adhesion elements
The default section scales the meshes by 0.1 and gives the geoms friction 0.5
The main default class makes every general actuator ctrl-limited

determinism.notes: the stand-in state is deterministic; a real MuJoCo run of the model was never made, and the bridge's seed is only recorded, it does not randomise the model's initial state

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in mujoco module, not the MuJoCo engine: it parses the integration step and the joint and actuator counts of model.xml and advances time (qpos follows qvel, which stays zero); it computes no equations of motion, contacts, adhesion or actuator dynamics, so a ctrl vector changes nothing in it

the package carries the model XML only (918 lines); the 80 mesh assets the XML references (.obj files, about 154 MB in flybody/fruitfly/assets) are not carried, so a real MuJoCo load needs that assets directory beside model.xml

the stand-in resolves each actuator's ctrlrange and ctrllimited from model.xml's default classes as the MJCF rules say (fruitfly.xml:11 makes every actuator ctrl-limited), so action.ctrl is bounded per actuator by the model's ranges; that resolution is the stand-in's, not MuJoCo's compiler

the clone's environment is a dm_control composer walker (flybody/fruitfly/fruitfly.py) with observations, rewards and termination; this package serves the raw model, not that environment, and the dm_control stack is not carried
snapshot and restore use the bridge's copied time/qpos/qvel/ctrl fallback, not mjSTATE_INTEGRATION
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by the model's timestep only
the fly model was never validated against a physical fly or against the upstream environment

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.
measures.name: native_checkpoint

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the world state stays readable
